name: Extended Form of the Mythical Beast
body:
You can assume mythical beast form for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Mythical Beast class feature.

Benefit(s): The duration of your Form of the Mythical Beast ability increases to five minutes per level, instead of one minute per level.
